note: The three testimonials published on vithean.com under 'Why people love Vithean'. Real named people with photos, already public with their agreement. Company name is an optional enhancement, not a precondition for publishing.

rules.note: Company name and a business outcome strengthen a testimonial and should be sought, but these three are publishable as they stand — they are already live.

quote.en: As a bookkeeper, I find it convenient posting entries with the multiple entry types for each module. I can work everywhere, anytime with an internet connection. I love that the summary of key information for reporting to management can be found on the dashboard.
quote.km: ក្នុងនាមជាអ្នកកាន់បញ្ជី ខ្ញុំយល់ថាការបញ្ចូលទិន្នន័យមានភាពងាយស្រួល ដោយមានប្រភេទធាតុចូលច្រើនសម្រាប់ម៉ូឌុលនីមួយៗ។ ខ្ញុំអាចធ្វើការគ្រប់ទីកន្លែង គ្រប់ពេលវេលា ដរាបណាមានអ៊ីនធឺណិត។ ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តដែលព័ត៌មានសំខាន់ៗសម្រាប់រាយការណ៍ទៅថ្នាក់ដឹកនាំ អាចរកឃើញនៅលើផ្ទាំងគ្រប់គ្រង។

quote.en: Vithean is a very helpful and accurate system. You can track and control your business without spending a lot of time. It has multiple languages, which is really convenient for government requirements and for a foreign owner. It is simple and easy to use.
quote.km: វិធាន គឺជាប្រព័ន្ធដ៏មានប្រយោជន៍ និងត្រឹមត្រូវ។ លោកអ្នកអាចតាមដាន និងគ្រប់គ្រងអាជីវកម្មដោយមិនចំណាយពេលច្រើន។ វាមានច្រើនភាសា ដែលងាយស្រួលសម្រាប់តម្រូវការរបស់រដ្ឋ និងសម្រាប់ម្ចាស់ជនបរទេស។ វាសាមញ្ញ និងងាយស្រួលប្រើ។

quote.en: Vithean is an accounting standard system and an accounting solution for any type of business. It can help all businesses, especially a company with a lot of transactions every day.
quote.km: វិធាន គឺជាប្រព័ន្ធគណនេយ្យតាមស្តង់ដារ និងជាដំណោះស្រាយសម្រាប់អាជីវកម្មគ្រប់ប្រភេទ។ វាអាចជួយអាជីវកម្មទាំងអស់ ជាពិសេសក្រុមហ៊ុនដែលមានប្រតិបត្តិការច្រើនរាល់ថ្ងៃ។

khmer.glossary: src/i18n/glossary.json — accounting terms extracted from the product's own km locale files. Those words are used verbatim here; do not substitute synonyms.
khmer.englishByDefault: Demo figures, document references and account names stay in English on both locales — most Cambodian accountants work in English for the ledger itself, and translating INV-2026-0412 or 'Accounts receivable' would make the example harder to verify.
khmer.verified: Strings marked VERIFIED were taken from the live vithean.com/km pages (archived in vithean-public/docs/existing/km/).
khmer.drafted: Everything else is drafted. Rule 1 of the bilingual policy is 'write Khmer, do not translate English' — headlines and value propositions must be authored by a Khmer-native writer working from the message house, not reviewed as translations.
